Hi Marissa / Rafael,

Quick note from the evaluation side — Anna and I walked through the Redwood checklist and the security team is asking for a scoped SOC2 extract (we need the parts that touch data segregation and logging). Procurement also flagged an internal approval window that pushes contract sign-off into the first week of November unless we compress approvals.

We still want Redwood in production this quarter but I want to be transparent: current internal windows make the 11/05 close date tight. Can we 1) share the requested SOC2 snippets, 2) update the MAP with adjusted gating so evaluation can continue while procurement runs approvals?

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Director of Digital Programs
Crestline Health

Subject: Re: (Crestline) MAP update & procurement timing

Priya — appreciate the heads up. Attaching a tailored SOC2 extract and a proposed MAP change that lets Eval run in parallel with procurement: short-term sandbox access + staged data subsets so Anna's team can complete the functional eval while legal/procurement finish the contract.

Proposed immediate actions (attached MAP_v2 + action log):
- Redwood to provide scoped SOC2 extract (attached) — today
- Staged sandbox access for Eval (no PHI) — target: 10/22
- Procurement milestone: we leave signature date flexible; MAP shows gating based on milestones not signature date

If Crestline can confirm sandbox recipients, we can spin this up quickly. Rafael — looping you for pricing/credits if we need to extend the sandbox window. Karthik — please weigh in on the canary and staging access risk controls.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — short answers:
- Sandbox logs: stored in a customer-scoped ephemeral bucket in our stage region; retention default 30 days, configurable to 7/14/30 for evaluation (we can set to 7 days for Crestline).
- No PHI in the sandbox by policy unless a private deployment is procured; we can help scrub any sample data.

Marissa — Friday 11/24 is coming up (typo) — I meant Friday this week (10/23) I'm available 10:30–11:30 PT for a walkthrough. Rafael / Laura, FYI: Anna may ask for a short conductivity demo showing latency and token breakdown for their typical prompt set. Could we provide a temporary credits package if evaluation runs past initial window?

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Marissa — quick update from procurement: approvals routed out to cost center leads next week, they expect a 7–10 day review after that. That pushes realistic signature to ~11/18 if there are no blockers. Given that, we want to lock down the MAP milestones and have a formal risk log so leadership can see mitigation steps. Can you provide the risk register and a short escalation note we can share with our CFO?

If Redwood can commit to the sandbox start and the shortened log retention during eval, we can proceed with the functional testing.

Regards,
Priya Rao
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: (Crestline) MAP update & procurement timing — MAP realignment + escalation note

Priya / Daniel — getting this in writing per your ask. Attached is the updated MAP action log (MAP_action_log_20261115.csv) and a short escalation note you can share with the CFO. Key points: 

Summary and proposed re-alignment:
- Original close target: 2026-11-05.
- Realistic close window per procurement: 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-22.
- Proposed approach: re-baseline the MAP to milestone-based gating rather than a hard signature date. This preserves the evaluation momentum and reduces business risk.

Top risks and mitigations (risk register excerpt):
1) Procurement delay — Risk: signature slips to late Nov. Mitigation: staged sandbox to enable production validation; Redwood to provide one month of extended eval credits (if needed) and priority onboarding slot the week after signature.
2) Security evidence gap — Risk: SOC2 excerpt insufficient for final sign-off. Mitigation: Redwood to provide a scoped SOC2 extract and offer a short security Q&A with our compliance lead; Karthik to confirm retention settings in writing.
3) Integration testing — Risk: integration with Crestline's SSO may take longer than Eval. Mitigation: provide a Light SSO drop-in guide and assign an SE touchpoint for the first 2 weeks of staging.

Action items (formalized):
- Redwood: enable sandbox (no PHI) by 2026-10-22 (done) and confirm 7-day retention setting — action: Karthik — due: 2026-10-21 (completed).
- Crestline: confirm sandbox users by 2026-10-23 (completed).
- Procurement: target signature window 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-22.
- Redwood: reserve onboarding slot week of 11/23 and prepare one-month eval credits — Rafael to confirm by 11/16.

Please review the attached files and let me know if you'd like the escalation note edited to include dollar figures or bespoke SLA terms. We're prepared to escalate to Laura (Head of Sales Ops) if Crestline needs an executive note for their CFO.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this cleanly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
